meta.name: browser-use
meta.description: Use Browser Use cloud API to spin up cloud browsers for Clawdbot and run autonomous browser tasks. Primary use is creating browser sessions with profiles (persisted logins/cookies) that Clawdbot can control. Secondary use is running task subagents for fast autonomous browser automation. Docs at docs.browser-use.com and docs.cloud.browser-use.com.

copy.tagline: 用云端浏览器自动执行网页任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端浏览器中自动完成网页操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate web tasks using cloud browsers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate web tasks in cloud browsers

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Browser Use 云 API 启动云端浏览器，让 Clawdbot 直接操控，或运行自动化任务子代理。
howto.when: 当你想让 Claude 在云端浏览器中自动执行网页操作（如登录网站、抓取数据）时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个带登录状态的浏览器会话。
say.note: 会调用 API 创建浏览器会话并返回连接地址。

say.text: 用浏览器自动去亚马逊查 MacBook Air M3 的价格。
say.note: 会创建一个任务子代理执行该操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the Browser Use cloud API to launch cloud browsers for Clawdbot to control directly, or run autonomous task subagents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want Claude to perform automated web tasks in a cloud browser, such as logging into sites or scraping data.

say_en.text: Create a browser session with a saved profile.
say_en.note: Calls the API to create a session and returns the connection URL.

say_en.text: Use the browser to find the price of MacBook Air M3 on Amazon.
say_en.note: Creates a task subagent to perform the operation.
